description: This file defines classes related to theme management, including loading themes from configuration files, stacking themes, and handling style data, primarily used within the rich console styling system.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Container for style information used by the console, capable of loading styles from dictionaries, files, and paths, and providing a configuration string.

classes.name: ThemeStack
classes.description: Manages a stack of themes, allowing themes to be pushed and popped with inheritance options.

classes.name: ThemeStackError
classes.description: Exception class for theme stack related errors.

methods.name: Theme.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Theme object with optional styles and inheritance settings.

methods.name: Theme.config
methods.description: Returns the theme's styles as a formatted configuration string.

methods.name: Theme.from_file
methods.description: Loads a Theme from an open configuration file.

methods.name: Theme.read
methods.description: Reads a Theme from a file path.

methods.name: ThemeStack.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a theme stack with a base theme.

methods.name: ThemeStack.push_theme
methods.description: Pushes a new theme onto the stack with optional inheritance.

methods.name: ThemeStack.pop_theme
methods.description: Removes the top theme from the stack, with error if only base remains.
